modules.text:
The sole objective for this project is to create a short length logo animation to be used as an ident in motion picture projects produced by the company.

We will opt for a one point 3D camera movement approach to the animation, to transform and bring some  sort  of  life  to  the  rather  flat 
1-dimensional form of the original logo. We beleive this will help convey the message of the concept more 
appropriately. 

The animation will be between a standard duration of 15-30 seconds in length with frame rate 30fps, 
screen resolution of 1920x1080 Full HD in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

“creation/revelation”
Trumpet Africa Productions is a Ghanaian established  film  production  company  on  a quest to explore and document stories that depicts the lives of Africans, thus telling the African  story  from  an  African perspective. 
The outfit takes special interest in promoting and  preserving  African  culture  through  films, music and various forms of performance arts.The  brief  for  this  project  was  simply  to develop a short piece of animation to be 
used as the production company’s ident. The animation is to be a reflection of the company and define what it stands for. 
The motif is based on the concepts of ‘Creation and  Revelation.’  These  facets  are  literally  in accord with the purpose that drives the entity as  a  film  production  company,;  creating  and developing projects that focuses and reveals stories on the lives of Africans. 

In this sense, we aimed at capturing the essence  and  value  of  being  African,  fixating attention  on originality,  identity,  richness  and creativity.

Albeit the animation will have more of an organic feel, the necessity to maintain or incoporate the company’s 
core brand colours (which already has presence of brown as a natural tone) still remains. Earth toned colours 
ranging from dark brown to black and gold are suitable colour choices for this project.

We consider introducing relatively organic and physical materials into a scene to give the mood of the animation a natural feel. Elements like clay, earth, sand and to some extent gold, will be incoporated within the animation.

In the storyboard we explain how we sought to help produce a piece that is easily recognizable and readily 
identified as African. 

The 30sec long animation captures a model African countryside setting, this is meant to make the company distinguishable as a  production  company  originating  from Africa.  It  goes  further  to  show  a  typical 
portrayal of an African storytelling scene. The objective was to portray the production company as an effective storytelling tool. 

The piece begins with a shot of a sunset scene  over  misty  hills  and  valleys  and gradually glides over a scenery and captures a flleet of birds and grazing goats, bringing naturalness and depth to the composition, 
it then goes over a compound and ends behind a “bonfire-storytelling” scene with an  oldman  (representing  the  storyteller) sitting in a circle with children listening on. 

We  finally  attempted  to  define  the company’s logo composition and depicting what  exactly  each  element  is;  two  facial expressions merging to form an abstraction of the African map, bounded by a trumpet on the left, both elements form the name of  the  production  company,  ‘TRUMPET AFRICA’.

CONCEPT   -  Jude Nyoagbe + Randy Biney 
STORYBOARD  -  Jude Nyoagbe + Randy Biney
ILLUSTRATIONS  -  Randy Biney 
ANIMATION   -  Randy Biney
